scripts.sync:defaults: rm -rf packages/core-go/internal/config/defaults/node-types/*.md packages/core-go/internal/config/defaults/report/template.html packages/core-go/internal/config/defaults/plan/template.md packages/core-go/internal/config/defaults/review/template.md packages/core-go/internal/config/defaults/workflow.yaml packages/core-go/internal/config/defaults/locales && cp packages/plugin/defaults/node-types/*.md packages/core-go/internal/config/defaults/node-types/ && cp packages/plugin/defaults/report/template.html packages/core-go/internal/config/defaults/report/template.html && mkdir -p packages/core-go/internal/config/defaults/plan && cp packages/plugin/defaults/plan/template.md packages/core-go/internal/config/defaults/plan/template.md && mkdir -p packages/core-go/internal/config/defaults/review && cp packages/plugin/defaults/review/template.md packages/core-go/internal/config/defaults/review/template.md && cp packages/plugin/defaults/workflow.yaml packages/core-go/internal/config/defaults/workflow.yaml && mkdir -p packages/core-go/internal/config/defaults/locales && cp packages/plugin/defaults/locales/*.yaml packages/core-go/internal/config/defaults/locales/
scripts.build:go: npm run sync:defaults && cd packages/core-go && go build -o graph-engine ./cmd/graph-engine && cd ../.. && npm run copy:bin
scripts.copy:bin: mkdir -p packages/plugin/libexec && cp packages/core-go/graph-engine packages/plugin/libexec/graph-engine && node -e "const v=require('./packages/plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json').version; require('fs').writeFileSync('packages/plugin/libexec/.version', v + '\n')"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run embed:web && npm run build:go && npm run build --workspace=@graph-ops/plugin --if-present
scripts.test: npm run sync:defaults && cd packages/core-go && go test ./... && cd ../.. && node --test scripts/*.test.js && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
